title: Development diagnosis of AND state-content recovery versus CASM execution
question: When the residual-linear integrated PLM remains weaker on AND than on XOR, is the error concentrated in queried persistent-state content recovery or in downstream AND execution?
hypothesis: The diagnostic will quantify queried-bit recovery and AND execution conditional on correctly recovered bits, separating state-content errors from downstream execution errors without using any confirmatory held-out outcome.

arms.name: normal
arms.intervention: hidden_dim=64 integrated PLM with residual-linear state write

decision_rule.condition: if AND execution error given both queried bits correct is substantial
decision_rule.licenses: downstream AND/CASM execution is a diagnosed contributor on the development split

decision_rule.condition: if AND state error rate dominates AND failures
decision_rule.licenses: persistent-state content recovery is a diagnosed contributor on the development split

interpretation_order: AND execution conditional on correct bits
held_constant: same registered 32-composition development set used for state-write selection
same five seeds and 300-step training budget
same optimizer, learning rate and weight decay
sealed E2E-005, E2E-006 and E2E-007 heldout outcomes excluded
no auxiliary payload-bit or entity supervision
same evaluation episode objects across seeds and diagnostic calculations

provenance.selection_rule: diagnosis only; no parameter or test-set selection from E2E-007 outcomes
